pages.text: LABEL blocks hold names. A name uses the letters a-z and A-Z, the digits 0-9 and the underscore. It must start with a letter.
Keywords in capitals are reserved: $(1)RESULT$() is not a valid name, but $(1)result$() and $(1)Result$() are. Library names use slashes, like $(1)c0de/math/PI$().
A label can point into a value with an $(l)index$(), like $(1)list[0]$(), $(1)stock["gold"]$() or $(1)problem.code$(). You enter the index as text in the LABEL dialog.
